description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast Grab, Spell Proficiency class feature or Reach Spell feat

Benefit: The time mage can focus as a swift action before casting Grab to increase its range to 50 ft. + 5 ft. per caster level. If the target of his Grab spell is outside of the spell's standard range at the start of his turn, the time mage must spend another swift action to focus again or the spell immediately ends.

system.requirements: Ability to cast Grab, Spell Proficiency class feature or Reach Spell feat
